1.0.0.body:
- Added Tab/System Audio Capture nodes to record Chrome tab or supported system playback audio as standard ComfyUI `AUDIO`, with saved recordings available to preview and reuse.
- Added Live capture for queue-time snapshots of recent audio, plus recording options for original PCM, configurable WAV, or AAC M4A formats.

1.1.0.body:
- Recorder now supports pause/resume without ending the sharing session; paused time is excluded from the recording timer and 10-minute limit.
- Live capture can save the latest audio without stopping capture or running the workflow, using configurable Original, WAV, or M4A settings. Saved recordings receive unused numbered filenames to avoid overwriting existing files.
- Added an Audio Meter for live left/right levels and an Audio Range Select node to preview and extract a waveform segment.
